subject: Orchid Conference — integrated booth workshop & brand placement request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidconf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Will Tran <will.tran@orchidconf.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orchid Conference — sponsorship SOW & activation ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday — excited to have Redwood as a Gold sponsor for Orchid (Oct 11–13). Attached is the current sponsor SOW (orchid_sponsor_sow_v3.pdf) with the base package and the bespoke integrated booth + workshop add-on we discussed. Key asks we need to finalize before we issue invoices:

- Final logo (PNG/SVG) for main stage build and mobile app banner
- Confirmation of the 60-minute workshop title and two speaker names (we have one speaker placeholder)
- Approval of the onsite interactive demo footprint (20x10) and any AV needs
- DocuSign signature for the attached SOW (we will provide link once we confirm final assets/changes)

Two quick notes on placement that differ from standard Gold: main stage banner edge placement is rotated this year to the left-facing riser. If you have a preferred placement, tell me within 72 hours and we can lock it.

Can you confirm who will own the workshop content and whether Redwood prefers a co-branded session or a Redwood-only workshop?

Best,
Samantha Lee
Sponsorship Director
Orchid Conference

Attachments: orchid_sponsor_sow_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidconf.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Conference — sponsorship SOW & activation ask

Samantha — thanks, received the SOW. Quick replies inline and an ask for a small amendment: please see our annotated sponsor map (rw-annotations-sponsor-map.png) for preferred logo sightlines and demo placement.

- Logo: we will provide both SVG and PNG. Preference: main stage app banner shows the full Redwood wordmark (not stacked) at 1200x300 px. You can embed our secondary mark on the demo pod.
- Workshop: Redwood will run a 60-minute hands-on workshop titled “Serving LLMs: Cost & Latency Tradeoffs” — speakers: Marissa Cole (Field Marketing) and Dr. Karthik Iyer (Prod Infra). We prefer a co-branded session with Orchid on the intro slides.
- Demo footprint: 20x10 OK; we will need a single 6ft table, power, and a single NDI camera line for streaming a short segment into the lounge livestream. I attached an internal AV checklist (rdw-av-requirements.xlsx).

Amendment request: please add a clause that guarantees the sponsor logo will not be reduced below 60% of the standard Gold placement size on any printed rack cards. We want to avoid last-minute shrinkage. If you can add that to v4 of the SOW we can sign quickly.

Also please send the DocuSign link once you’ve added the logo size clause — we can route to Legal for a quick look but want to move to signature this week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: rw-annotations-sponsor-map.png (PNG, 420KB); rdw-av-requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidconf.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Conference — sponsorship SOW & activation ask

Looping in ops notes — quick operational items we need confirmed before sign:

- AV: NDI camera line available + single HDMI feed for the workshop. If Orchid can provide the NDI endpoint, we’ll bring a switcher.
- Build: demo pod must have a lockable storage bin. Need measurements for the 20x10 carpet tile orientation.
- Staffing: Redwood will provide two brand reps per day; confirm exhibitor badges (2 per day or full-event badges?).
- Lead capture: confirm whether Orchid provides lead scans or if we must supply our own.

If Samantha can confirm these items we can clear logistics and confirm final headcount.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Events Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidconf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Will Tran <will.tran@orchidconf.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Conference — sponsorship SOW & activation ask

Hi Marissa / Kimberly — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and the detail. Answers below and next steps: 

- Logo: confirmed — we will accept SVG. I’ve asked our designer to reserve the left-facing riser for Redwood wordmark per your spec. We will note the 60% minimum size in the SOW addendum.
- Workshop: co-branded is fine. I’ve tentatively locked a workshop slot on Oct 12 at 10:30am (60 minutes). Please send final speaker bios (one paragraph each) by Aug 5 so we can publish in the app.
- AV & demo: Orchid can provide an NDI endpoint and a single HDMI source. We can confirm camera latency window during load-in. Lockable storage for the demo pod is standard; I’ll include measurements in the exhibitor build packet (will share link).
- Badges: we will issue full-event exhibitor badges for two people; add-ons can be purchased through the exhibitor portal.
- Lead capture: Orchid provides lead-scanning devices and will share CSVs after the show.

I’ve asked legal to add the logo-size clause and will re-issue SOW v4 via DocuSign by Monday. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rdw-orchid-2026 (same as related links). Once signed, we’ll issue the invoice for the remaining balance and add the workshop to the agenda.

On a separate note — would Redwood like a 15-minute lightning stage mention (sponsor shout) between main-stage morning sessions? We can usually add 1–2 of those for Gold sponsors; confirm if you want to include that value.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Sponsorship Director
Orchid Conference
